caseName: Bacardi Corp. of America v. Bonet
caseNameFull: Bacardi Corporation of America v. Bonet, Treasurer

opinions.text: Manuel I. Domen-ech, present Treasurer of Puerto Rico, substituted as a party respondent in the place and stead of Rafael Sancho Bonet, former Treasurer, on motion of Mr. Preston B. Kavanagh for the petitioner.
